hash_scope: Prior reviewed gene-to-paper audit JSON; not original paper bytes

Park2010.citation: Park et al., Journal of Surgical Oncology 2010
Park2010.scope: Gene-labelled microarray RNA associated with copy-number change in gastric tumor AND normal tissue. Probe cross-reactivity unresolved; does not validate restriction.

Wollenzien2023.citation: Wollenzien et al., Molecular Cancer Research 2023
Wollenzien2023.scope: Low RNA signal in human SCLC models. Publisher-indexed table inspected; original XLSX retrieval unavailable. Functional GAGE2A/PAGE5 validation is not transferred to these genes.

Geng2012.scope: DUX4-induced germline program in human myoblasts. Not cancer-expression validation; the cited preimplantation background concerns mouse biology, not direct human TRIM64 reproductive restriction.

Traynor2022.citation: Traynor et al., Frontiers in Oncology 2022
Traynor2022.scope: Melanoma gene-labelled RNA; SSX7 very low. SSX4 evidence is not transferred to SSX4B in this gene-level audit.

Gure2002.citation: Gure et al., International Journal of Cancer 2002
Gure2002.scope: Historical small tissue panel; SSX7 in one of nine melanoma lines.

Song2022.scope: Tumor and adjacent colorectal protein signal. Adjacent-tissue signal is a restriction concern.

Amoushahi2020.citation: Amoushahi et al., Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics 2020
Amoushahi2020.scope: Human ovarian follicles, oocytes and granulosa cells; reproductive expression, not tumor validation.

Shukla2018.scope: MAGEA2B among eight melanoma CRMA expression-cluster genes. Gene-labelled RNA, with duplicated-locus attribution limitations.

Caballero2014.scope: SSX4B-labelled microarray signal in DCIS versus normal mammary samples; probe specificity versus SSX4 is unresolved. Online December 2013, collection 2014.

Kristensen2008.scope: REX1/ZFP42 reproductive and germ-cell-neoplasm expression; does not cancel reported skin expression.
